correctness.rationale: The second GMRES iterate has the exact form \(x_2=ab-cAb\). Orthogonality of the residual to \(A\mathcal K_2\) gives two moment equations. Their exact solution makes \(c>0\), while \(a/c\) is a positive weighted average of active spectral pair sums. Hence \(a/c\ge2\mu\), proving componentwise nonnegativity when \(L/\mu\le2\). For every larger condition number the explicit three-point spectrum and stated right-hand-side bound force \(a/c<\kappa\), so the top-eigenvalue coordinate is negative. Degenerate one- and two-point active spectra are handled separately by exact Krylov termination. The exact verifier replays the moment identities and rational witness.

value.rationale: A nonnegative exact solution can be important in positive linear models, yet residual minimization alone does not protect the positive orthant. The result gives a natural complete classification for the first nontrivial GMRES step on the simplest SPD class: condition number two is the exact dimension-free safety frontier, and three active modes are minimal for failure. The pair-sum formula also explains the mechanism and yields an explicit counterexample for every larger condition number, making the fact reusable rather than a one-off numerical anomaly.
